BSF Kills Two Suspected Pakistani Intruders in Punjab

The Border Security Force (BSF) shot dead two suspected Pakistani intruders along the Punjab border. The incident occurred in the Tarn Taran district during an infiltration attempt. All reporting outlets identified the deceased as suspected Pakistani intruders.
